name: NMEA Gateway
summary: Streams the NMEA 2000 bus to Signal K over Wi-Fi
description:
A small tap on the NMEA 2000 backbone: every CAN frame goes over Wi-Fi to Signal K in candump format, where canboatjs decodes it, and frames Signal K sends go back onto the bus (or never, in receive-only mode). It decodes nothing itself, so new PGNs need only a server update.

Needs a CAN transceiver (an SN65HVD230 module, for example) between the board and the bus, except on boards that have one. Pins are set on the device's settings page. NMEA 0183 over a serial port is planned as an option in the same firmware.

boards.notes: Wire a CAN transceiver to GPIO 4 (TX) and GPIO 5 (RX), or set other pins in the settings.
